Skills and Hands NT Pty Ltd is a Northern Territory-based consultancy focused on workforce planning, talent engagement, and sustainable staffing strategies. Our role is to facilitate practical workforce solutions that help employers attract and retain skilled talent—contributing to the resilience and continuity of operations across the Territory.

About the business
The business (ABN 24 638 483 600) is a locally owned real estate agency in Darwin, Northern Territory, servicing Darwin and Palmerston. They provide real estate sales, rental, property management and client-focused real estate services. They are seeking an experienced Sales and Marketing Manager to lead agency growth, sales strategy, marketing campaigns and client acquisition.

About the Role
The Sales and Marketing Manager will plan, direct and coordinate the agency’s sales and marketing activities. The role will focus on growing property listings, improving brand visibility, developing client acquisition strategies and supporting the agency’s long-term business growth in the Darwin and Palmerston property markets.

Duties and Responsibilities
The successful applicant will be responsible for:
- Developing and implementing sales and marketing strategies for the agency.
- Leading campaigns to attract property sellers, buyers, landlords and tenants.
- Setting sales targets, marketing objectives and business development plans.
- Managing marketing budgets, campaign priorities and promotional activities.
- Reviewing market trends, local property data and competitor activity.
- Developing strategies to grow the agency’s property management portfolio and sales listings.
- Managing brand positioning, client engagement and digital marketing direction.
- Coordinating advertising campaigns for properties and agency services.
- Supporting and guiding staff involved in sales, marketing, leasing and client engagement.
- Building relationships with clients, referral partners, contractors and community networks.
- Monitoring campaign performance, enquiry conversion and business development outcomes.
- Preparing management reports and recommendations for business growth.

Skills and Experience Required
Applicants must have:
- A bachelor degree or higher qualification in business, marketing, management or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
- At least 3 years of experience in sales, marketing, business development or management.
- Demonstrated ability to develop and implement sales and marketing strategies.
- Strong leadership, communication and negotiation skills.
- Experience managing campaigns, budgets, performance targets and client relationships.
- Strong understanding of digital marketing, lead generation and customer engagement.
- Experience in real estate, property services or professional services will be highly regarded.
- Ability to analyse market trends and use data to support strategic decisions.
- Current driver licence is desirable.

How to Apply
We are looking for professionals who are passionate about real estate and can demonstrate their experience clearly and confidently.
To apply, submit the following:
- Resume outlining your work experience and references.
- A short cover letter (max. 300 words) explaining:
- Why you are applying for this position; and
- An example of when you showed excellent service, initiative, or teamwork (use the STAR method: Situation, Task, Action, Result).
- A Written Response (max. 600 words) describing how your skills and experience align with the responsibilities of the role you are applying for. Please structure your example(s) using the STAR method.

* Only complete applications that address all three components will be considered. Incomplete or generic submissions will not be shortlisted.

If you are interested in joining a dynamic real estate team and contributing to exceptional property and client experiences, we look forward to receiving your application.

Apply online only. Walk-in or telephone enquiries regarding this vacancy will not be accepted.

result.description:
Concrete Support Services (CSS) is a fully independent concrete testing and engineering consultancy supporting construction projects right across Melbourne. From our laboratory and field operations, we deliver concrete testing, materials assessment and technical advice that builders, contractors and engineers rely on to keep their projects moving and compliant. Because we operate as a completely independent laboratory, our clients know that every result we issue is backed by integrity, confidentiality and impartiality. Our work aligns with Australian Standards and NATA requirements, and our team combines decades of hands-on concrete technology expertise with a genuine commitment to service. What sets us apart is speed paired with accuracy we understand that critical site activities can’t wait, so we go out of our way to turn around reliable field and laboratory results promptly and to consistently exceed what our clients expect. As we continue to grow, we’re looking for a motivated Civil Engineering Technician to join our team at Oakleigh South and play a hands-on role in delivering the quality and responsiveness our clients count on.

Key Responsibilities
•	Carry out and coordinate a full program of on-site and in-laboratory tests on concrete, construction materials and soils including sampling fresh concrete, casting and curing specimens, slump and compressive strength testing all in accordance with Australian Standards.
•	Interpret job briefs, project specifications and work assignment instructions, then apply the appropriate testing procedures and select the correct equipment for each task.
•	Record, collate and analyse test results, perform the associated computations, and enter data accurately and promptly into our laboratory data-management systems so clients receive fast, dependable results.
•	Prepare technical sketches, charts, tabulations and test reports that support civil engineering works such as roads, drainage, water supply and sewerage reticulation systems, dams and structural elements where concrete and materials testing is required.
•	Conduct site inspections of concrete and civil works, and help organise and oversee sampling, re-testing and remedial or maintenance verification where required.
•	Estimate material quantities and associated costs, and check that materials and finished works comply with specifications, regulations and relevant contract provisions.
•	Collect field data during site surveys and sampling runs including on road, pavement and infrastructure projects and consolidate it for analysis and reporting.
•	Calibrate, maintain and correctly operate field and laboratory testing equipment, and keep clear records of its condition and use.
•	Uphold the laboratory’s quality management system and safeguard the integrity, impartiality and confidentiality of every result, in line with NATA and Australian Standards requirements.
•	Liaise professionally with clients, site supervisors and project engineers, providing clear technical support and rapid feedback to accommodate critical site timelines.
•	Support concrete mix design and quality-control activities, contributing observations and data that help clients meet their construction project needs.
•	Follow all workplace health and safety procedures and contribute to a safe, well-organised working environment both on site and in the laboratory.

About You
•	Strong attention to detail and a methodical, accurate approach to testing and record-keeping.
•	Reliable, punctual and able to manage priorities to meet time-critical site demands.
•	A team player who communicates clearly and professionally with colleagues and clients.
•	Committed to integrity, impartiality and confidentiality in all aspects of the work.
•	Safety-conscious, with a genuine respect for standards, procedures and compliance.
•	Physically capable of the practical, hands-on aspects of field and laboratory testing.
•	Willing to learn, take direction and grow within a supportive, quality-driven team.

Qualifications & Experience
•	An AQF Associate Degree, Advanced Diploma or Diploma in a relevant civil, engineering or materials-related discipline.
•	At least 1 year of relevant experience.

What We Offer
•	Salary:  $75,000 – $85,000 plus superannuation per annum.
•	Hours: Full-time position, typically 38 hours per week.
•	Location: Oakleigh South, VIC.

How to Apply
If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you. Please submit your resume together with a brief cover letter outlining your relevant experience and qualifications.
